```{=html}
<script>
const CORRECT_HASH = "ac95cc34e3ff9d4e59fd3066f6feaee0d2f4f7f97d3865148bc5767834883ff5";
async function sha256(msg) {
  const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(msg));
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map(b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("");
}
async function checkPw() {
  const hash = await sha256(document.getElementById("pw-input").value);
  if (hash === CORRECT_HASH) {
    document.getElementById("pw-overlay").style.display = "none";
    sessionStorage.setItem("rscripts_unlocked", "1");
  } else {
    const err = document.getElementById("pw-error");
    err.textContent = "Incorrect password. Please try again.";
    document.getElementById("pw-input").value = "";
    document.getElementById("pw-input").focus();
    setTimeout(()=>{ err.textContent=""; }, 3000);
  }
}
if (sessionStorage.getItem("rscripts_unlocked") === "1")
  document.getElementById("pw-overlay").style.display = "none";
</script>
```

```{=html}
<div class="fn-card">
<div class="fn-header">
  <div>
    <h4 class="fn-name" id="fn-distrib">distrib(x, k=6)</h4>
    <div class="fn-desc">Compute a compact NA-cleaned numeric summary: N, min, Q1, median, mean, Q3, max.</div>
    <div class="fn-tags"><span class="fn-tag tag-stat">statistics</span><span class="fn-tag tag-util">utility</span></div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="fn-args"><span class="fn-args-label">Args:</span><span class="fn-arg">x — numeric vector</span><span class="fn-arg">k=6 — decimal places</span></div>
```

```{r fn_statistics_distrib_0, eval=FALSE}
distrib <- function(x, k = 6) {
  # NA removing
  x <- x[is.na(x) == FALSE]

  Nx <- length(x)
  sum <- round(summary(x), k)
  res <- c(Nx, sum)
  names(res) <- c("N", names(sum))
  return(res)
} # end of function distrib
```

```{=html}
<div class="fn-header">
  <div>
    <h4 class="fn-name" id="fn-hms-span">hms_span(start, end)</h4>
    <div class="fn-desc">Format the elapsed time between two POSIXct timestamps as HH:MM:SS.</div>
    <div class="fn-tags"><span class="fn-tag tag-util">utility</span></div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="fn-args"><span class="fn-args-label">Args:</span><span class="fn-arg">start — POSIXct start time</span><span class="fn-arg">end — POSIXct end time</span></div>
```

```{r fn_statistics_hms_span_1, eval=FALSE}
hms_span <- function(start, end) {
  dsec <- as.numeric(difftime(end, start, unit = "secs"))
  hours <- floor(dsec / 3600)
  minutes <- floor((dsec - 3600 * hours) / 60)
  seconds <- dsec - 3600 * hours - 60 * minutes
  paste0(
    sapply(c(hours, minutes, seconds), function(x) {
      formatC(x, width = 2, format = "d", flag = "0")
    }),
    collapse = ":"
  )
}
```

```{=html}
<div class="fn-card">
<div class="fn-header">
  <div>
    <h4 class="fn-name" id="fn-sesandpvalues-bis">sesandpvalues_bis(obs, rand, nreps, probs, rnd)</h4>
    <div class="fn-desc">Standardised effect size (SES) and p-value from an observed value vs. a null randomisation vector.</div>
    <div class="fn-tags"><span class="fn-tag tag-stat">statistics</span></div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="fn-args"><span class="fn-args-label">Args:</span><span class="fn-arg">obs — observed value</span><span class="fn-arg">rand — null distribution vector</span><span class="fn-arg">nreps — number of randomisations</span><span class="fn-arg">probs=c(0.025,0.975) — CI bounds</span></div>
```

```{r fn_statistics_sesandpvalues_bis_2, eval=FALSE}
sesandpvalues_bis <- function(obs, rand, nreps, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), rnd = 2) {
  SES <- (obs - mean(rand)) / sd(rand)
  pValsSES <- rank(c(obs, rand))[1] / (length(rand) + 1)
  results <- round(c(obs, SES, mean(rand), quantile(rand, prob = probs), pValsSES, nreps), rnd)
  names(results) <- c("Observed", "SES", "MeanRd", "CI025Rd", "CI975Rd", "Pval", "Nreps")
  return(results)
}
```

</div>

```{=html}
<div class="fn-card">
<div class="fn-header">
  <div>
    <h4 class="fn-name" id="fn-extract-t-test">extract_t_test(x, y, ...)</h4>
    <div class="fn-desc">Run a Welch t-test and return a tidy data frame with means, SDs, t-statistic, p-value and significance stars.</div>
    <div class="fn-tags"><span class="fn-tag tag-stat">statistics</span></div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="fn-args"><span class="fn-args-label">Args:</span><span class="fn-arg">x — first numeric vector</span><span class="fn-arg">y — second numeric vector</span></div>
```

```{r fn_statistics_extract_t_test_3, eval=FALSE}
extract_t_test <- function(x, y, ...) {
  z <- t.test(x, y)
  stat <- z$statistic
  pval <- z$p.value
  pvalStars <- ifelse(pval > 0.05, ".",
                      ifelse(pval > 0.01, "*",
                             ifelse(pval > 0.001, "**", "***")))
  est <- z$estimate
  sdv <- c(sd(x), sd(y))

  res <- data.frame(est[1], sdv[1], est[2], sdv[2], stat, pval, pvalStars)
  res[1:4] <- round(as.numeric(res[1:4]), 2)
  names(res) <- c("Mean x", "sd x", "Mean y", "sd y", "t", "Pvalues", "P")
  return(res)
}
```

```{=html}
<div class="fn-card">
<div class="fn-header">
  <div>
    <h4 class="fn-name" id="fn-extract-indices-list">extract_indices_list(ind)</h4>
    <div class="fn-desc">Compute SES (Observed, SES, MeanRd, CI, Pval) for each column of an index matrix.</div>
    <div class="fn-tags"><span class="fn-tag tag-stat">statistics</span><span class="fn-tag tag-fd">functional diversity</span></div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="fn-args"><span class="fn-args-label">Args:</span><span class="fn-arg">ind — matrix of observed vs. randomised indices</span></div>
```

```{r fn_statistics_extract_indices_list_4, eval=FALSE}
extract_indices_list <- function(ind) {
  indSES <- matrix(
    NA, nr = ncol(ind), nc = 7,
    dimnames = list(
      colnames(ind),
      c("Observed", "SES", "MeanRd", "CI025Rd", "CI975Rd", "Pval", "Nreps")
    )
  )
  for (i in 1:nrow(indSES)) {
    indSES[i, ] <- sesandpvalues_bis(
      obs = ind[1, i],
      rand = ind[-1, i],
      nreps = length(ind[, 1]) - 1,
      probs = c(0.025, 0.975),
      rnd = 2
    )
  }
  rownames(indSES) <- gsub("\\.", " ", rownames(indSES))
  return(indSES)
}
```

```{=html}
    <div class="fn-desc">Absolute difference in functional indices across two conditions.</div>
    <div class="fn-tags"><span class="fn-tag tag-stat">statistics</span><span class="fn-tag tag-fd">functional diversity</span></div>
```

```{r fn_statistics_extract_indices_change_5, eval=FALSE}
extract_indices_change <- function(ind) {
  indSES <- matrix(
    NA, nr = ncol(ind), nc = 7,
    dimnames = list(
      colnames(ind),
      c("Observed", "SES", "MeanRd", "CI025Rd", "CI975Rd", "Pval", "Nreps")
    )
  )
  for (i in 1:nrow(indSES)) {
    indSES[i, ] <- sesandpvalues_bis(
      obs = ((ind[2, i] - ind[1, i]) / ind[1, i]) * 100,
      rand = ((ind[-c(1:2), i] - ind[1, i]) / ind[1, i]) * 100,
      nreps = length(ind[, 1]) - 2,
      probs = c(0.025, 0.975),
      rnd = 2
    )
  }
  rownames(indSES) <- gsub("\\.", " ", rownames(indSES))
  return(indSES)
}
```

```{r fn_statistics_extract_indices_change_log_6, eval=FALSE}
extract_indices_change_log <- function(ind) {
  indSES <- matrix(
    NA, nr = ncol(ind), nc = 7,
    dimnames = list(
      colnames(ind),
      c("Observed", "SES", "MeanRd", "CI025Rd", "CI975Rd", "Pval", "Nreps")
    )
  )
  for (i in 1:nrow(indSES)) {
    indSES[i, ] <- sesandpvalues_bis(
      obs = log(ind[2, i] / ind[1, i]),
      rand = log(ind[-c(1:2), i] / ind[1, i]),
      nreps = length(ind[, 1]) - 2,
      probs = c(0.025, 0.975),
      rnd = 2
    )
  }
  rownames(indSES) <- gsub("\\.", " ", rownames(indSES))
  return(indSES)
}
```
